explanation: It is often confused with Slovakia, which lies further north-east and also borders Austria and Hungary. Slovenia even has a short stretch of Adriatic coast.

claims.text: Slovenia borders Italy, Austria, Hungary and Croatia.

Slovakia lies north-east of Slovenia and borders Austria and Hungary.
Slovenia has a short coastline on the Adriatic Sea.
